text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Declaration! We are holding the "Campus Concentration Tournament"!
The prize, sponsored by the cafeteria staff, is a "Special Meat Course Voucher"!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For Brian's sake as well,
I shall claim victory here!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide-senpai displays remarkable memory,
matching cards with pinpoint accuracy!
Could Special Week-san be at a severe disadvantage here?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
............No, I won't give it up.
Meat......... the meat... is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Spe-chaan! If you win, we'll hold a massive Meat Festival to make up for holding back, deees!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ngh!! The pair for this card is—this one, desu!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable, Special Week-san has matched another pair on her very first tryyy!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Matching pairs that haven't even been flipped once yet...
that's beyond luck, she's practically blessed by the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Or is that sheer focus born of "hunger"?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oops, if it isn't that Trainer from back then.
Sorry, but I don't have time for chitchat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
After all, my next opponent is Spe herself.
—The battle has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's finally time for the finals! Having crushed
a lineup of formidable contenders, Special Week-san!
Will she put that miraculous luck on display against her final opponent as well?!

text_block_list.name: Spe's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Do your best! Spe-chan!!
Take the win just like that!
(Grumbleee~...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah?! M-My stomach is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Must've burned through quite a bit of brainpower.
...Want a piece of candy?

Though the start felt somewhat lacking in tension,
the curtain has finally risen on the finals!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Here we go in the finals. Once again, Special Week-san
closes her eyes! Is that special technique about to unleash once more?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Meat... meat... meeaaat!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable, for the first time in the entire tournament, the pair didn't match!
Where has that unstoppable momentum from earlier gone?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No way, right?!
Wh-Where did all my luck go...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Maybe you still don't have enough sugar to focus?
...Want another piece of candy?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu...
Haaah... Whyyyy...?

In the end, however, Special Week was unable
to regain her stride...

The one who claimed victory in the match and took home the prize
was Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Can I really have this?!
The "Special Meat Course Meal Voucher"...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Consider it thanks for keeping me entertained.
See ya... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, spying on us?
Can't say that's a very classy hobby.
choice_data_list: Was that just now... a bribe?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! Don't be ridiculous!
What kind of idiot pulls such cheap tricks?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't need the prize, so I just gave it away.
All I did was a little "disruption."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Now that I think about it, your persistence is legendary.
Sigh... I'm only explaining this once, got it?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember?
Spe's "habit."
choice_data_list: Closing her eyes before drawing a card...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Right. And to make herself even hungrier,
she amplifies the mental image by putting it into words.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Meat... meat...
I wanna eat meat...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whether she was doing it consciously or not, I can't say.
But El also told Spe it was 'for all that holding back.'
Chances are she'd been skipping meals since morning... completely starved.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Starved, completely ravenous... sharpening her intuition to razor-sharp edge.
That's what allowed Spe to seize such monstrous luck.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But what if her desire for food got satisfied?
For instance... with a single piece of candy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A slight sense of discord. The feeling of gears slipping out of place.
...That tiny flicker of impatience began eating away at the intuition that drew in her monstrous luck.
choice_data_list: In other words, what you did was...
In other words, what you did was...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...If you could win on luck alone, nobody'd have to sweat it.
Every now and then, you gotta use this up here.
